messages:
Sam: Diana confirmed for onsite Tue 10:00am. Need to lock check-in flow, quiet coding room, travel stipend/taxi voucher. cc @Maya @Nish
Maya: On it — I can reserve a quiet room by Eng floor and send the calendar invite with door code. Any dietary or accessibility notes?
Nish: I'll host. Prefer candidate arrives 9:45 so we can set up. Please arrange loaner laptop + HDMI. Adding @IT Support.
IT Support: We can prep a loaner image and HDMI dongle. Which image? We can stage `redwood-intv-ubuntu-22.04` with sample creds. Will need someone to sign loaner agreement on pickup.
Maya: Noted. Also we cover local transit up to $120 or provide a taxi voucher. I can prepare an Uber prepaid voucher + physical taxi slip at the front desk. Sam, please DM candidate phone for pickup text.
Sam: DM'd the number to Maya. Also Diana asked for a quieter keyboard / low-scent environment due to allergies.
Maya: Reserving Room 5-3 (small interview room) 9:30–1:00 and flagging Facilities for a cushion + lower desk. Door instructions for front desk: "Escort candidate to 5F, Room 5-3".
Maya: Door code (share only with host): `4321#`
CalendarBot: Event created: "Diana — SWE onsite" with Zoom fallback. Link: https://calendar.redwood.com/event/abc123
Sam: I'll bring printed prompt, candidate resume, and a spare set of headphones.
Nish: I'll bring my charger and a spare HDMI cable. I'll arrive 9:15 to test setup. If we're delayed, fallback is Zoom + shared whiteboard.
Maya: Stipend options: (1) hand candidate a taxi voucher + reimbursement form, or (2) Venmo/PayPal on-site transfer. For corporate taxi use front desk code `77-RED`. Candidate must submit receipt within 14 days for reimbursement.
IT Support: Loaner image ready: `redwood-intv-ubuntu-22.04`. Temporary password: `Redwood!23` (we'll rotate after pickup). Recommend candidate use incognito for any personal accounts.
Sam: FYI candidate asked about parking — we have a visitor pass for Lot B at entrance gate. I'll add pass number to the calendar invite.
Maya: Facilities confirmed cushion and low desk. I'll print a sticky note: "Redwood Interview — please escort to 5F" and leave it at reception.
Nish: All good from my side. Looking forward to meeting her.
Sam: Thanks everyone — I'll update the invite and DM any last-minute details. :thumbsup:
Maya: Done — invite updated, door code in host-only notes. I will bring the taxi voucher and the reimbursement form to reception.
